title: Improved generalization bounds for binary linear classification via isoperimetry
abstract: arXiv:2505.16713v4 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: We examine the concentration of uniform generalization errors around their expectation in binary linear classification problems via an isoperimetric argument. In particular, we establish Poincar\'{e} and log-Sobolev inequalities for the joint distribution of the output labels and the label-weighted input vectors, which we apply to derive concentration bounds. The derived results improve upon existing bounds obtained from general unbounded empirical processes, as well as that tailored specifically to logistic regression. In asymptotic analysis, we also show that almost sure convergence of uniform generalization errors to their expectation occurs in very broad settings, such as proportionally high-dimensional regimes. Using this convergence, we establish uniform laws of large numbers under dimension-free conditions.

translated_title: 通过等周不等式改进二元线性分类的泛化界
translated_abstract: 摘要：arXiv:2505.16713v4 公告类型：替换-交叉 摘要：我们通过等周论证研究了二元线性分类问题中均匀泛化误差围绕其期望的集中性。具体而言，我们为输出标签和标签加权输入向量的联合分布建立了Poincaré和对数Sobolev不等式，并将其应用于推导集中界。所得结果改进了现有从一般无界经验过程获得的界，以及专门针对逻辑回归的界。在渐近分析中，我们还表明，在非常广泛的设置下（如比例高维情形），均匀泛化误差几乎必然收敛于其期望。利用这种收敛性，我们在无维数条件下建立了均匀大数定律。
tldr: 本文通过等周不等式为二元线性分类建立新的集中界，改进了现有结果，并在比例高维等广泛设置下证明了均匀泛化误差的几乎必然收敛性。
en_tdlr: This paper establishes new concentration bounds for binary linear classification via isoperimetric inequalities, improving existing results, and proves almost sure convergence of uniform generalization errors in broad settings like proportionally high-dimensional regimes.
